models.name: Bonsai 2 2B
models.why: The smallest ternary Bonsai 2 — 0.43GB, fast enough for a phone and absurdly quick in an M4 Max browser demo.

engines.hardware: M4 Max (browser demo, Apple Silicon, MLX via PrismML)
engines.quant: browser demo on an M4 Max; PrismML's own reported figure, no quant named in the post

models.name: Bonsai 2 9B
models.engine_min_version: ternary GGUF packings need PrismML's llama.cpp fork; upstream llama.cpp loads only the Q2_0 file
models.why: Ternary 9B vision-language model in about 2GB that an iPhone 18 Pro Max runs at 34 tok/s, and an open optimization challenge pushed it past 900 tok/s on Apple Silicon.

engines.hardware: Apple Silicon (PrismML + DarkbloomAI optimization challenge track on mlx.fast / Yukon Research)
engines.quant: open optimization challenge runs, mlx.fast Apple Silicon track, from 144.9 to 913.1 tok/s in five days (reported 442.3% gain)
